_note: Semantic layer of the Config view: hand-written prose per config.yaml key. Values (engine default / effective / truth ref / drift) are computed on every build and never live here. Point paths.config_descriptions.<lang> at a file like this; the view builds without one, but then it shows values only.
_rule: Describe the MECHANICS of a key, not a snapshot of state. 'Enabled in production' rots at the first edit; 'read at access time, so no restart is needed' stays true.
_flags: redline — do not touch without a conversation; alias — the engine stores the key under a different name; dormant — asleep because the parent is disabled; temp-off — disabled temporarily; nested — meaning lives on the parent key; ours — key is not in the engine schema (your own extension).

sections.hint: who answers, who steps in on failure

keys.text: The main model the agent thinks with. Declared as the string `model` in the engine defaults and expanded to the dict `model.{default,provider,base_url}` on save — the map reconciles both forms through an alias table.
Provider of the main model. Decides how the request is authenticated (OAuth subscription vs API key) and therefore whether the traffic is billed per token.
Wildcard entry: one description for every key under fallback_model. Which model answers when the primary fails, and how the failure is detected.
